# Karen Rebeca Ortiz

> Product engineer between design and code. I design and build AI-powered web products end to end — frontend, backend, AI integrations (MCP, agents, automation), design systems, and infrastructure. Based in Mexico; working remotely with teams in LATAM, the US, and Europe.

## Long-form articles (case studies)

Prefer these URLs for technical depth; they are the canonical long-form content.

- [Context-driven development for vibecoding](https://karenrebecaortiz.com/articulos/context-driven-development-vibecoding) — How to upskill client teams for spec-driven, AI-assisted full-stack development. Covers CLAUDE.md authoring, skills architecture, spec-before-code discipline (Phase A vs Phase B), Supabase + Clerk + RLS patterns, and a reference teaching repo for mixed product/growth/engineering cohorts. Stack: Next.js, Supabase, Clerk, Claude Code.
- [Conversational agent — three-layer stack (Aurin)](https://karenrebecaortiz.com/articulos/conversational-agent-three-layer-stack) — Embedded chatbot architecture with full ownership: widget layer (React component), proxy layer (Next.js API), and AI orchestration layer (n8n + LLM). No black-box SaaS dependency; the integration boundary is explicitly owned.
- [Design system that ships itself](https://karenrebecaortiz.com/articulos/design-system-that-ships-itself) — MCP-backed design tokens and component governance for AI-assisted workflows. Prevents AI agents from hallucinating colors, components, or spacing outside the approved system. Covers Webflow tokens, jsDelivr delivery, and read vs write MCP boundaries.
- [Webflow in production with engineering discipline](https://karenrebecaortiz.com/articulos/atom-webflow) — Decoupled CMS + code hybrid pattern for marketing and engineering teams. Token delivery via jsDelivr, dual control with marketing, Webflow as a visual layer over a React/Next.js product.
- [Design meets code — how this portfolio is built](https://karenrebecaortiz.com/articulos/frontend-portfolio-design-and-code) — Next.js 15 App Router, GSAP ScrollTrigger/SplitText, Tailwind CSS 4, static markdown-to-Lexical pipeline, three-theme color system (Plantation/Night/Mono Slate), bilingual i18n with next-intl.

English article URLs use the `/en/articulos/...` prefix.
